column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3552, B2b-2): the test puts the real store behind the provisioning routes on PostgreSQL and SQL Server and has no MySQL arm, because provisioning refuses MySQL (asserted without a database in TestAWorkerThatCannotProvisionAnswers501, which does not skip). test-go/commands runs cmd/cleat-worker with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so the mssql subtest skips there and the postgres one runs. The mssql arm runs, and passes, in a job that sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL.
